result.analyst_notes: The page is largely factual and business-descriptive, opening with market position, scale and headcount. Values appear in short sections on stewardship and accountability. The first-person plural voice appears only in the stewardship section, and its commitment is hedged ('we strive') rather than absolute. Shareholder and safety themes are absent.
